column2: It's nothing like that. Honestly, you worry too much, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}I found a place with a beautiful view, so I thought we could go together.{wait}{clear}
I know things are hard right now, but I wanted you to see that view too, ＄＄＄＄＄＄...{wait}{clear}
I see... Will you take me there? It's precisely because of times like these that we should go see it.{wait}{clear}
Yes... you're right... After all, that view is something we have to protect...{wait}{clear}
Come, Leyla, where is it?{wait}{clear}
Huh? Oh, yes, this way.{wait}{clear}
I... wanted to talk with you too, Leyla...{wait}{clear}
You did... I'm glad...{wait}{clear}
Say, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, there's a view I want to show you.{wait}{clear}It's because of times like these that I want to see it with you...{wait}{clear}
Of course.{wait}{clear}If you say so, Leyla, then I'd like to see that view too.{wait}{clear}
Really? Then let's go.{wait}{clear}
Rudi, what's wrong? Has something terrible happened?{wait}{clear}
You didn't have to rush over like that. I just felt like talking a bit, that's all.{wait}{clear}
So that's what it was. I thought something had happened...{wait}{clear}
You really are a worrier, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. At this rate, I can't call you even when I want to see you.{wait}{clear}
No, please do call me.{wait}{clear}I... want to see you too, Rudi...{wait}{clear}
Huh? Oh, is that so...?{wait}{clear}W-well, um, let's talk a bit. Since you came all this way and all.{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry... What was I panicking about...?{wait}{clear}
Come on, you don't have to look so down, do you? Don't worry about it so much.{wait}{clear}Hey, you're here now, so let's talk.{wait}{clear}
Ah, Rudi...! Is there something you wanted to talk about?{wait}{clear}
Yeah, I wouldn't call you without a reason. You always seem so busy, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}Would you keep me company for a bit?{wait}{clear}
Yes, I wanted to as well...{n}
Nah, nothing like that. Did I end up making you worry instead?{wait}{clear}
No. I just assumed that on my own... I'm sorry.{n}{wait}{clear}
You really are a worrier, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}Hey, will you come along with me? I found a perfect spot for talking.{wait}{clear}
Well then, let's go.{wait}{clear}
Yes, I... wanted to talk with you too, Rudi.{wait}{clear}
Oh, so that's how it was. I was worried about what to do if I got in your way, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
Well, since you're here, will you come along with me? I found a perfect spot for talking.{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry! I came as soon as the fairy told me, but was I too late?{wait}{clear}
Geez, you can't even take a joke, can you?{wait}{clear}
A joke...?{wait}{clear}
Hahaha... Still, I'm glad you hurried over that fast.{wait}{clear}
Hey, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, do you have some time?{wait}{clear}
Yes, I'm free.{n}
Well... I'm a little...{n}
Yes, of course I'm free.{wait}{clear}
I see. Then we can have a nice long talk.{wait}{clear}I know things are hard right now, but it's okay to relax a little, right?{wait}{clear}
I see... Good...{wait}{clear}
Well... actually, I have something to take care of...{wait}{clear}
I see... So you can't stay for a while?{wait}{clear}
